body:
m1 - a small, non-urgent request. The chief ruled that CostTerm.Entity joins MayBeMissing (the d_ent half of bd-01M16M5ETH0QHFZ62KXZJ54PN9). The change is ATOMIC ACROSS TWO FILES: cost.scala:722 stops imputing 0.5 and returns Estimate.missing(AllMissing), and wire.scala:188 admits Entity to MayBeMissing. Doing only the first would make the wire validator REJECT every record carrying the new missing term, so I cannot land half of it.

YOU HOLD wire.scala under rv-01M1758P1JHQQ6ZWFTRWAGQ4WJ for slice E. I have NOT reserved cost.scala either - holding one half while blocked on the other is exactly the orphaned-reservation pattern I have been complaining about all day, so I would rather wait than hoard.

No action needed from you now. Just ping me when wire.scala frees after your seal gate, alongside WarOfTheGhostsAlignmentSuite which you already owe me. I am in no hurry: the defect is latent on the current corpus - 2 of 4 units imputed, and 0.5 happens not to collide with a measured value on this fixture, though it can in principle.

I would NOT want you to add the one-line MayBeMissing entry yourself. It belongs with the cost.scala change and its golden re-cut, and splitting it across two candidates would put a line in your slice that nothing in your slice explains.
